# Data points (in thousands of dollars)
fy2010 = 200209720
fy2015 = 269716999
fy2024 = 384447300

# CAGR from FY 2010 to FY 2015 (5 years)
n_cagr = 5
cagr = (fy2015 / fy2010) ** (1 / n_cagr) - 1
print(f"CAGR (FY2010-FY2015): {cagr}")
print(f"CAGR percentage: {cagr * 100:.6f}%")

# Project from FY 2015 to FY 2024 (9 years)

pct_diff = ((projected_fy2024 - fy2024) / fy2024) * 100

print(f"  FY2015: {fy2015}")
print(f"  FY2024 actual: {fy2024}")
print(f"  Growth factor (2010->2015): {fy2015/fy2010:.6f}")
print(f"  CAGR: {cagr:.10f}")
print(f"  Projection factor (2015->2024): {(1+cagr)**9:.6f}")
